info.name: Dentist Booking API
info.description:
Term project: Dentist Booking System (group HelloWorld).

Select the **Dentist Booking - Local** environment. Run **Auth → Register** then **Login (user)**; the login test script saves the JWT to `{{token}}`, and every request inherits `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` from the collection. Admin requests use `{{adminToken}}` (run **Login (admin)** after the seed data from T17 exists).
